fc_selection: Use the utility-feasible FC preset with lowest mean merged development accuracy in the parent screen; no test-based choice.
decomposition: Split the actual published V edit into the LayerNorm affine-null component and its orthogonal remainder; do not rescale either component.
test_usage: Fixed causal contrasts and one FC configuration selected from earlier training development data; no test hyperparameter search.
design_timing: Designed after the parent's V recovery result; not an independent pre-registration.
parent_metric_reuse: Original and full V standalone/direct/AGA counts are copied with provenance, not counted as new evaluations.
